correctness.rationale: All defining polynomials and field calculations have been reconstructed using exact rational arithmetic. The three divided wedge equations have Groebner basis {u+Q(v)/51168936, P(v)/412}; discriminant gcd rules out collapsed pairs; source independently proves these seven distinct pairs are all ordinary nodes. A nonzero symmetric node coordinate implies field inclusion, and the Q-rational normalization fiber forces equality. Modulo 79 P is irreducible, modulo 199 P is squarefree with factorization (1,1,1,1,1,2). Degree seven primitivity and a transposition imply S7. All numerical and algebraic certificates are directly recomputed by verify.py; no finite sample substitutes for the infinite-field proof.

value.rationale: The lead construction intrinsically singles out the complete seven-node stratum of a rational sextic with an exceptional rational A5 point. Computing all node residue fields and their minimal S7 splitting field is a natural arithmetic descent classification not implied by the geometric singularity census; it determines the Galois permutation representation on the seven exceptional curves after blowing up those nodes. The fact concerns the entire natural finite node set, not an arbitrary unmotivated subcase, and the exact irreducibility/transposition certificates establish nontrivial content. It is appropriately limited to the named sextic.
